entities.name: Castan
entities.description: A vedalken Izzet attendant and scientist on Ravnica who helped find the missing chemister Erno Zslod; her ultimate fate is unknown.

entities.name: Erno Zslod
entities.description: Izzet chemister who vanished over thirty years earlier, found as a preserved head and killed.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Guildmaster to whom Madarrak brought the beacon.

entities.name: Johrum
entities.description: Erno's assistant, morphed into a fire-twisted being who saved Madarrak.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: Insectoid hordes that attacked in the Undercity.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: Guild whose sentries followed the party.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the events occur.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Ruined depths of Ravnica where Erno was found.

events.summary: Castan and Madarrak find a homing beacon after a machine breaks through a lab wall.
events.quote: Madarrak found a type of homing beacon, which moved of its own volition

events.summary: Madarrak learns the beacon belonged to the vanished chemister Erno Zslod.
events.quote: the device once had belonged to the chemister Erno Zslod

events.summary: Castan, Madarrak and Yzaak follow the beacon into the Undercity.
events.quote: Madarrak and Castan entered the Undercity of Ravnica

events.summary: They find the still-alive head of Erno Zslod inside a mizzium helmet.
events.quote: the still-alive head of none other than Erno Zslod

events.summary: Castan destroys three Kraul warriors with a lightning spell as more attack.
events.quote: Castan sent an arcing lighting spell into them

events.summary: A mutant pins Madarrak; Johrum, transformed, frees him.
events.quote: freeing the guildmage from its monstrous grasp
finally ending the mad chemister's life

events.summary: Madarrak flees and Castan is left alone surrounded by Kraul; her fate is unknown.
events.quote: Castan was left alone in the Undercity, surrounded by hordes of Kraul

relations.quote: Castan was working with her mentor, the guildmage Madarrak
Bringing his apprentice the cyclops retainer Yzaak with them
